posts.text:
Joined local officials today to provide an update on flood response and recovery efforts. 

Thank you to every first responder, volunteer, and neighbor stepping up for our communities. 

The cross standing on the hill is a powerful reminder of the faith and resilience that define our Hill Country. 
We’ll keep working until the job is done. #HillCountryStrong
posts.summary: Supports community flood recovery and resilience efforts

posts.text:
Toured Blanco, Kerr, Kendall, and Gillespie counties today. 

More than 200 rescues were made during this flood thanks to heroic first responders. The water is down, but recovery is just getting started. 

Keep these communities in your prayers, we’ll be posting ways to support each community impacted #TX21

posts.text:
Along with significant flooding impacting communities across our TX-21 district along the Pedernales, Guadalupe, Medina, and Nueces river basins, our neighbors in Uvalde County have been taking it on the chin with RECORD rainfall.

With another round of storms possible tonight, let’s keep them in our prayers and continue supporting the families, first responders, and local officials working through this difficult time.

posts.text:
Johnson City and Blanco Co remain a concern as floodwaters continue moving downstream from Gillespie

Please continue to heed all warnings from local officials, stay away from rivers/low water crossings, and never drive through flooded roadways. Stay alert and stay safe #TX21
